name: Landhaus Alpenrose
beschreibung: The Landhaus Alpenrose is a traditional inn in Tirol, Österreich. It is situated amid the impressive Alpine landscape, surrounded by dense forests and green mountain meadows. The rooms are comfortably furnished and offer breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains. The in-house restaurant serves regional cuisine made with fresh ingredients. The cozy atmosphere of the inn invites you to relax and enjoy nature. The inn is ideal for hikers, nature lovers, and families seeking peace and relaxation.
